basics.name: Takieddine Soualhi
basics.label: Research Engineer in AI & Robotics
basics.summary: Postdoctoral research engineer in AI and Robotics at Inria Lyon (CHROMA team), working on multi-agent reinforcement learning for human-robot coordination.

work.name: INRIA, CHROMA Team
work.summary: Introducing novel MARL methods for human-agent coordination.
highlights: Introducing novel MARL methods for human-agent coordination.
Conducting large scale simulations and deploying trained models for industrial partner (Enchanted Tools).
Integration of the ROS2 navigation stack into the partner's humanoid robot.

work.name: CIAD lab
work.summary: PhD research on deep reinforcement learning for mobile robot visuomotor control.
highlights: Conduct literature review, identify literature, and set scientific goals.
Build custom RL training environments and training robots.
Propose novel RL and MARL algorithms for training single and multi-robot systems on vision-based control tasks.
Deploy the trained models on real robots.
Publish results in top-tier robotics journals.

work.name: University of Burgundy and Franche-Comté
work.summary: Teaching courses in computer science and robotics.
highlights: Courses: C Programming, Operating Systems, Web Applications, Robotics.
Supervision of students semester projects.

work.name: LINEACT lab
work.summary: Machine learning for human-robot interaction datasets.
highlights: Preprocessing and cleaning the InHard multimodal human-robot interaction dataset.
Collecting and building a custom dataset using MoCap data in VR.
Proposing, implementing, and evaluating deep learning models for both the InHARD dataset and the newly collected dataset.
Shipping code along with documentation.

work.name: LoopAI
highlights: Literature review on facial expression recognition.
Evaluation of CNN and GAN-based models on the FER dataset for facial expression recognition.

work.name: Sorbonne University / ISIR lab
work.summary: Research on autonomous driving simulation and deep learning.
highlights: Building a simulation scene and its corresponding real scene for autonomous driving.
Fine-tuning deep learning models for scene understanding.
Implementing control and planning algorithms.
Shipping code along with demo of the platform.

work.name: AEPI NewVision
work.summary: Mentoring students in DIY robotics and electronics projects.
highlights: Building DIY projects, including robots, electronic boards, IoT templates.
Mentoring students and supervising DIY projects.
Presenting projects and participating in conferences.
